findings: smoke.mjs PASS at session start (6/6, chromium 141, SwiftShader).

MEASURED, as shipped: questionnaire.reachableClasses() exhaustive over all 40 race x upbringing pairs (41,943,040 routes) reaches 11 of 14 named classes IN PRINCIPLE, but exact-set matching means a random-answer sweep of 1,600 runs produces 0 exact matches. Both the critic's 0/240 and the item's >=10/14 metric are true at once: the route can reach 11 but never does.

ROOT CAUSE of 0/14 in play: matchNamedClass() requires SET EQUALITY of both the top-3 and the top-2 skill sets against a class. C(19,3)*C(16,2) = 116,280 shapes, 14 of them named. Exact match is a measure-zero event in play.

CANDIDATE MATCHER MEASURED: bias-corrected nearest-profession fit. E[s] = expected weight of skill s under uniform answering over the ASKED question set (sum over answers weighting s, /4); w'[s] = w[s]-E[s]; fit(c) = sum over c's skills of (3 if 25 else 2) * w'[s]. Over all 41,943,040 routes this reaches 14 of 14 distinct classes. Over a 240-run random sweep it also reaches 14 of 14, histogram min 4 max 35. Naive unnormalised affinity reaches only 5 of 14 — the bias correction is what does the work.

fit percentiles over 4,000 random runs: p1 3.00, p5 4.75, p10 5.75, p25 7.50, p50 9.75, p90 15.75. A floor of 4.0 leaves roughly 4% of routes unnamed (the honest 'I do not have a word for that' band).

ROOT CAUSE of the custom-route throw: census.js _options() for source 'progression/attributes.json#attributes' and '#skills' returns EVERY option and ignores inp.excludes ('favoured_attributes' / 'primary_skills'). Only the birthsign branch honours excludes. So the pick node offers already-taken attributes and _requirePick throws out of stepFrames.
buildCensusModel (scene.js) never reads state.question — census.state() DOES return {question:{id,index,text,answers}} at questionnaire nodes. One field.

FIXED + MEASURED: question texts reaching the frame 0 of 10 -> 10 of 10. buildCensusModel now sets line = state.question.text at questionnaire nodes, with the scribe's stock framing demoted to a `preamble` drawn once at question one. Live Census walk shows 10 distinct question bodies (q1..q8,q10,q11 for a saxhleel/interior character), 17 distinct drawn lines over the scene.

FIXED + MEASURED: named classes 0 of 14 -> 12 of 14 over the critic's own 240-run sweep shape (10 races x 4 upbringings x 6 answer patterns, verified even histogram a/b/c/d = 600/600/600/600), and 14 of 14 exhaustively over all 41,943,040 routes. 97.10% of routes name a class; the other 2.90% get the authored 'I do not have a word for that'.

FIXED: census.js _options() now honours inp.excludes via _excluded(); the neglected node offers 8 attributes not 10, secondary offers 16 skills not 19. Pad walk (caret-at-top + interact on every node) completes the custom route with 0 throws and attribute total 112.
FIXED: Engine._censusApplyPending() now catches, emits a `census_refused` event and shows the refusal as the scribe's aside instead of throwing out of the fixed step.

FOUND + FIXED (second-order, same defect class as the headline gap): every REPLY in the census graph was written to the transcript and never drawn — on_answer, on_refusal, birthsign scribe_line, the writ.strange-check conditional branches, and on_match_named_class itself, which RI-CHR01 SS4 calls 'the moment the route is for'. census.state() now carries `spoken` and ui.js draws it above the rule.

creation-audit: CHR03-dry-well-removes-focus was stale against ARBITRATION S27 and was the one hard failure at 88/90. Re-pointed to CHR03-dry-well-takes-the-hearth plus a new CHR03-S27-no-focus-rate sweep over all 9 signs. Now 90/91 PASS, 0 hard failures, 1 declared XFAIL (the corpus's own Nord/Orsimer collision).

R3-RESUME: converse.js + engine wiring for greetings/topics was ALREADY ON DISK from the killed run (game/src/character/converse.js, engine.js talkTo/conversationSay/conversationClose/_conversationStep, harness api). It was never executed. First live run found it threw.

BUG FIXED: Engine.conversationSay() emitted 'dialogue_topic', which is NOT in events.js EVENT_TYPES, so every topic utterance threw out of the harness. 'topic_select' was already in the A-JRN7 vocabulary and is exactly this event. Reused it rather than extending the closed vocabulary.

MEASURED (live, helstrom-market, 4 NPCs x 10 races = 40 conversations): greetings.json DOES now reach the frame. 40/40 conversations open with a line, 31 distinct lines, 16 distinct greetings.json cells reached, and 4/4 NPCs greet different races differently.
MEASURED (live): race DOES now change the topic list. 4/4 NPCs offer different topics to a Dunmer than to a Saxhleel. The round-2 'byte-identical' finding is closed.

BUT — SECOND-ORDER DEFECT the consumer exposed: a Saxhleel (the native race) is offered ZERO topics by 3 of the 4 Helstrom NPCs. 'race changes topics' passes while the native race can talk to nobody. This is exactly the W1-09 'moved the defect somewhere else' failure mode and must be closed before the consumer counts.

ROOT CAUSE, measured across all 15 NPC records and all 306 topic ids: (a) 13 distinct topic ids referenced by NPC records DO NOT EXIST in dialogue/topics/*.json at all — including the whole opening: jeeh-ei's the-hold/your-hatch-name/what-they-take-off-you and tuleeh-ma's the-writ/tidewrack/my-work/the-list/lukiul; (b) 22 further topic ids exist but have NO info written for the referencing NPC's actor. 13 of 15 NPC records are affected.

ROOT CAUSE (b) detail: 0 of 306 topics has a single actorless (generic) info — every info names an actor in `a`. So infoFor()'s `generic` fallback is dead code for actored NPCs. Separately, 5 of 15 NPC records have actor:null, and infoFor's `if (!generic && !actor) generic = info` hands an actorless NPC ANY actor's line — a net-mender can speak a fisher's line by accident. The rule is backwards in both directions.

Actor vocabulary mismatch measured: topic infos are dominated by sapcutter(97)/archivist(96)/rootkeeper(88)/legionary(84)/mudborn(68), while NPC records carry clerk(2)/merchant(2)/villager/outlaw/legionary/dres-factor/townsman/naga-elder and 5 nulls.
